test_scenario: Upload a valid DOCX resume and click Analyze Resume
expected_result: Resume text should be extracted and analysis should complete without errors

test_scenario: Upload a valid text-based PDF resume
expected_result: Text from all PDF pages should be extracted and analyzed
remarks: Create or obtain a test PDF resume before running

test_scenario: Upload a file with an unsupported extension
expected_result: Application should reject the file or show a clear validation message
remarks: Verify uploader restricts file types to PDF and DOCX

test_scenario: Extract technical skills from the sample resume
expected_result: Only skills present in the resume and skill dictionary should be detected
remarks: Compare displayed skills with resume content

expected_result: Detected skills should appear under their correct categories
remarks: Check Programming, Machine Learning, NLP and Tools categories

test_scenario: Compare resume skills against job role requirements
expected_result: App should calculate match scores and list missing skills for available roles

test_scenario: Display the top three job role recommendations
expected_result: The three highest-scoring roles should be displayed in descending score order
remarks: Compare displayed order with complete matching results

test_scenario: Generate a learning roadmap for missing skills
expected_result: Missing skills should display their available beginner learning topics
remarks: Check Docker, PyTorch or SQL if listed as missing

test_scenario: Check the job role comparison chart
expected_result: Chart should display job roles with their corresponding match scores
remarks: Verify chart values match analysis results

test_scenario: Use Analyze Another Resume reset button
expected_result: Previous analysis results should clear and app should return to upload state
remarks: Confirm old results are no longer visible
